mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest way to use AI for social media content planning and repurposing?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A limited budget is a good reason to begin with an existing asset and a narrow workflow rather than buying a large collection of tools. You can test AI-assisted outlining, caption drafting, repurposing, and calendar organization before paying for advanced video, scheduling, or analytics features.

Context: Run My AI Biz offers a free starting option through its newsletter and lists a paid subscription of $9 per month for full weekly issues. That educational subscription is separate from any third-party AI, scheduling, design, or platform costs.

Key factors:
- Compare total monthly cost, not just advertised price.
- Check export, storage, and usage limits.
- Avoid paying for overlapping features.
- Value your review time as part of the cost.

Practical guidance: Run a two- to four-week test using one source and one or two platforms. Upgrade only when a specific limitation is costing more than the added tool would save.

A small, measurable experiment is safer than assembling a costly stack immediately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with one existing source, a free or already-paid AI tool, and one or two platforms. Test drafting and repurposing before buying specialist software. Include subscription fees, platform costs, media tools, and your editing time when judging value.
